description: Fetch live matches for a sport, or upcoming fixtures, recent results and league tables for any FlashScore competition URL.

dayOffset.description: Days from today for the live/daily feed: 0 is today, -1 yesterday, 1 tomorrow. Range -7 to 7.
dayOffset.title: Day offset

leagueUrls.description: FlashScore competition URLs for fixtures, results and standings, e.g. https://www.flashscore.com/football/england/premier-league/. Past-season archive URLs work too.
leagueUrls.title: Competition URLs

liveOnly.description: In live mode, keep only matches currently in progress. Set false to return every match scheduled for that day.
liveOnly.title: Live matches only

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records across the whole run.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to fetch: live or daily matches for one sport, or fixtures, results and standings for competition URLs.
mode.title: Mode

sport.description: Sport for live/daily matches. Competition modes read the sport from each league URL.
sport.title: Sport

title: FlashScore Live Scores, Fixtures, Results & Standings Input
